whySubline.title: WHY SUBLINE
whySubline.item1Desc: Prediction markets open opportunities rarely covered by classic tools. The service lets you work with both PM ↔ PM and PM ↔ BK pairs in one place.
whySubline.item2Desc: Unlike classic bookmaker scenarios, working with prediction markets offers a more flexible format and reduces dependency on limits, account cuts and restrictions.
whySubline.item3Desc: Our service shortens the path from finding a discrepancy to entering a trade. Fewer tabs, less manual routine, less time spent on verification.
whySubline.item4Desc: Signals, filters, calculators, alerts and trade entry tools are all in one interface so you can work faster and with greater control.
whySubline.item5Desc: While you earn, your activity on prediction markets can simultaneously work toward a future airdrop.

howItWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.subtitle: SubLine finds price discrepancies between platforms, shows a ready opportunity and helps you enter a trade quickly.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Every platform has its own odds on the same event. Because of differences in probability assessment between markets, spreads appear — price discrepancies you can profit from.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The service automatically matches identical events across platforms, compares prices and finds arbitrage combinations. You immediately see the potential profit, ROI and entry parameters.
howItWorks.step3Desc: You enter one event on different outcomes and lock in profit from the price difference between platforms regardless of the result. SubLine helps you enter the trade with the best profit %.
howItWorks.exampleSubtitle: The service found an arbitrage opportunity for us and we enter the trade.
howItWorks.exampleBet1Desc: Team 1 — odds 2.30. We bet $100. If they win we earn $230. Taking into account the second bet, our net profit is $30.
howItWorks.exampleBet2Desc: Team 2 — odds 2.15. We bet $100. If they win we earn $215. Taking into account the first bet, our net profit is $15.
howItWorks.exampleConclusion: As you can see, it doesn't matter at all who wins or loses. We profit regardless of the outcome — earning a small % profit on every such opportunity.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What do I need to get started?
faq.a1: You need a computer or laptop, a subscription to the service, and accounts on supported platforms — prediction markets and/or bookmakers with a small deposit to work with. After that, you can immediately start tracking arbitrage opportunities and entering your first trades.
faq.q2: Do I need experience in arbitrage?
faq.a2: No. The service is designed to be as simple and straightforward as possible for beginners. Just read the onboarding guide and practice with small amounts. Most users get comfortable within a few days.
faq.q3: How much money do I need to start?
faq.a3: A large deposit is not required. We recommend starting with small amounts to get familiar with the interface and mechanics. You can start with as little as $10, but for meaningful results, working with a deposit of $150 or more is more comfortable.
faq.a4: You control your own funds and work directly with the platforms — you don't transfer a deposit to our service. SubLine is an analytical tool that helps you find arbitrage opportunities and calculate trades, but all operations are executed by you from your own accounts.
faq.q5: Are there any limits on trade size?
faq.a5: It depends on the specific platform and market liquidity. Prediction markets often have good liquidity, but on some events volume may be lower. That's why we show liquidity directly in the opportunity card, so you can immediately understand how much you can enter without unnecessary risk.
faq.q6: Are there any difficulties or nuances?
faq.a6: Yes — the key factor here is reaction speed. Arbitrage opportunities appear in real time and can disappear fairly quickly. Sometimes you have about a minute to open both sides of a trade. But this comes with practice: your first trades might take 30–40 seconds, and over time you'll be doing it in just a few seconds.
faq.a7: Your income depends on your deposit, reaction speed, liquidity, and the number of opportunities available on a given day. Trades can yield up to 40% ROI, and throughout the day the service may find dozens of opportunities. Keep in mind that results always depend on how quickly you can enter a trade and the size of your position.
faq.q8: Which subscription plan should I choose?
faq.a8: We have several subscription options. The weekly subscription is great for testing the service and understanding how it works in practice. The monthly subscription is the most popular option — it gives you not only access to the service, but also access to a private community of users with discussions, experience sharing, useful materials, and support.

oddsScanner.name: Odds Scanner
oddsScanner.desc: Real-time arbitrage opportunity detection between prediction markets and bookmaker platforms. Scans bookmaker lines and compares odds. Instant market data updates and arbitrage recalculation.

marketMatching.name: Market Matching
marketMatching.expand: The system automatically matches identical events between platforms. After matching, bookmaker lines are compared to identify odds discrepancies.

marketsBetTypes.name: Markets & Bet Types
marketsBetTypes.expand: Allows you to select match categories, event type (Live or Pre-Match) and bet types. The service scans events from multiple sports categories and finds opportunities across various markets: Match Winner, Handicap, Total, etc.

positionCalculator.name: Position Calculator
positionCalculator.expand: Calculates the optimal stake distribution for the found spread. Shows maximum profit taking into account available liquidity on each platform and selected odds.

autoBetSetup.name: AutoBetSetup
autoBetSetup.expand: A pop-up tool for quick entry on a found spread. Automatically calculates bet amounts for your specified deposit and shows the required odds on each platform. Helps you enter a trade even if lines start moving.

liquidityFilter.name: Liquidity Filter
liquidityFilter.expand: Allows you to set a minimum liquidity threshold for displaying opportunities.

profitRoiFilter.name: Profit & ROI Filter
profitRoiFilter.expand: Allows you to set minimum profit and yield percentage for displaying opportunities.

arbAlerts.name: Arbitrage Alerts
arbAlerts.expand: Receive notifications when new opportunities appear. The system monitors matches and notifies you when it detects profitable spreads between platforms.

cancelProtection.name: Cancel Protection (<50c)
cancelProtection.expand: Displays only positions priced below 50c on Polymarket. If an event is cancelled, the market settles at 50c, so entering at this price avoids a loss or yields a profit.

arbitrage.name: Arbitrage
arbitrage.desc: Real-time arbitrage opportunity detection between prediction markets. Scans markets and compares contract prices. Instant market data updates and arbitrage recalculation.

pmPm.name: PredictionMarkets <> PredictionMarkets
pmPm.expand: The service finds arbitrage opportunities between all supported Prediction Markets. Each platform is matched with others, allowing arbitrage opportunities to be found between any combination of markets.

arbDetection.name: Arbitrage Detection
arbDetection.expand: An AI-powered event matching system that compares markets across platforms. Identifies price discrepancies and helps find spreads.

arbCalculator.name: Arbitrage Calculator
arbCalculator.expand: Calculates the optimal position distribution for the found opportunity between platforms. Shows potential profit accounting for fees and slippage.

telegramAlerts.expand: Receive real-time Telegram notifications when new arbitrage opportunities are detected. Notifications are fully customisable to your parameters and filters.
